title: 2 ways AI is changing Meta Ads
description: 2 ways AI is changing Meta Ads
transcript: I've spent more than $200 million on meta ads, and the game is changing faster now than ever before. The main reason for that is AI, and it's affecting the platform in two major ways. Firstly, AI is involved a lot more in Meta's optimization and delivery process. That has automated a lot of things for US advertisers. There are things that we don't need to worry about very much anymore. Things like targeting, placement options, all sorts of settings that used to be really important for US advertisers to get involved with. That frees up our time as advertisers to focus on ad creative. And that's the other massive area that's being affected by AI. With AI, advertisers are able to create a lot more creative less expensively and faster. That allows for a lot more creative tests, a lot more experimentation, a lot more creative volume, which is leading to significant gains in creative quality. And some advertisers that are willing to go through that work and do it all and run those tests and produce literally hundreds of ad creative are winning
